name: Heat Haze
description: Shimmering heat waves rise through the frame, strongest at the bottom, making the first clip wobble like the air over hot asphalt; the second clip shows through the haze and settles as it calms. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: strength
params.description: How far the haze bends the picture, in frame heights (the strongest waves bend it about 1.5 times as far)

params.name: scale
params.description: Size of the heat waves: more, smaller ones with a larger value

params.name: speed
params.description: How fast the heat waves rise
